Онлайн-вариант, устанавливать не нужно —: Online option, nothing to install — Google Translate (12 seconds for 120 test lines). Quality sits between LibreTranslate and TranslateGemma: calques appear, but the translation is closer to natural than to a "rough machine"; it tries to use phrases and idioms, though often unsuccessfully. The main problem is that it is a free unofficial service: after 15–30 minutes of work Google blocks the connection for 12–24 hours.
Важно: модели очень зависят от видеопамя: Important: the models depend heavily on video memory. The sharp jump in time between Gemma 4 Q4 and Q6 is not a typo: the model did not fit into the test card's video memory. All measurements were made on an RTX 3070; your values will differ, so follow the wizard's recommendations and do not install a model that is more demanding than your system.
Видеокарта не нужна: работает на процесс: No graphics card needed: runs on the CPU (also suitable with less than 4 GB of video memory).
Быстрый, но качество заметно ниже. Часто: Fast, but the quality is noticeably lower. Often translates roughly and word for word, produces unnatural phrasing, errors of meaning and formatting problems — a classic "machine translation". Almost all phrases are translated in the masculine, even for female characters.
About 6 GB of video memory required.
Приемлемое качество при высокой скорости: Acceptable quality at high speed. Mostly preserves the meaning and style of the original, handles descriptive prose and phrases sentences better than LibreTranslate. Sometimes literal, not quite natural expressions appear; it can confuse the speaker's gender.
About 8 GB of video memory required.
Уже хорошее качество: связные и в целом: Already good quality: coherent and generally natural translations. Conveys the main idea, emotional shades, intonation and the speaker's tone, and handles wordplay. Calques, awkward phrases and grammatically imperfect constructions appear only occasionally. The text is closer to literary than to machine translation.
About 12 GB of video memory required.
То же, что Gemma 4 12B Q4 QAT, но лучше: Same as Gemma 4 12B Q4 QAT, but conveys emotions, wordplay and jokes of the original better and builds sentences better; calques are practically absent.
